items.title: RBI Monetary Policy: Rates raised by 25 bps, stance changed to 'calibrated tightening'
items.summary: With this rate hike, the RBI has joined other major global central banks, including the US Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank (ECB), the Bank of Japan (BoJ) and the Bank of Korea (BoK) who have embarked on a policy tightening cycle.

items.title: Commodity Corner: Oil gains on supply fears; gold holds firm as yields ease
items.summary: Gold held gains as increasing oil supplies from the Middle East and a decline in bond yields eased pressure on the US Federal Reserve to hike interest rates this month.

items.title: Gold flat as focus turns to Fed minutes
items.summary: Gold prices remained steady as market participants look forward to insights from the Federal Reserve's upcoming meeting minutes. Spot gold hovered at $4,159.62 per ounce, while December futures were valued at $4,187.30. Amid ongoing inflation and recent sluggish economic indicators, Fed discussions around interest rate hikes are influencing investor sentiment, with many opting for yield-generating assets over gold.

items.title: Gold Steady as More Oil and Falling Yields Ease Rate-Hike Bets
items.summary: Gold held gains as increasing oil supplies from the Middle East and a decline in bond yields eased pressure on the US Federal Reserve to hike interest rates this month.

items.title: Fed plans bank-supervision overhaul to strengthen accountability, says Vice Chair Michelle Bowman
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is set to realign its bank supervision system for increased accountability and efficient decision-making. Five new geographic supervisory regions will be established, each led by a regional leader. This new structure aims to address concerns raised in an independent review of Silicon Valley Banks collapse. The Fed will also reconsider asset thresholds for regulatory requirements to better align with inflation and economic growth.

items.title: Gold steady as firm dollar counters softer US rate-hike bets
items.summary: Gold prices demonstrated stability amidst a stronger dollar, which countered the positive effects of moderating Federal Reserve rate hike anticipations. The price for spot gold remained steady at $4,141.81 per ounce, while US gold futures experienced a slight increase, reaching $4,169.10. The ongoing rise in interest rates raises the opportunity cost associated with gold, making it less appealing for investors.

items.title: US Market: Fed’s Hammack says jobs data gives time to assess rate path
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials have signalled they have time to assess incoming economic data before making further changes to interest rates. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said Septembers weak employment report was broadly consistent with recent labour-market trends. With hiring slowing but remaining stable and inflation pressures persistent, policymakers are weighing employment and price stability before the next rate decision.

items.title: Gold inches up as October Fed rate hike prospects fade
items.summary: During early Monday trading in Asia, gold prices surged due to lackluster US job growth figures. This disappointing employment data notably diminished the Federal Reserve's likelihood of raising interest rates in October, prompting investors to pivot towards safe-haven assets. Spot gold climbed to $4,153.32 per ounce, while silver and platinum also experienced price increases as market reactions unfolded. Economic trends are steering investment behaviors in precious metals significantly.
